race.comment: MAGIC BLAZE (2) has not raced since closing strongly to get up for second on debut over 1100m at Gosford in June. Trialled twice in October to get ready for this assignment. Looks to have more talent than most of these so a successful return looks on the cards. The obvious threat is ZOURRIFIC (6) who also returns today after just one run back in June, a handy third over 1150m at the Kensington track when a short-priced favourite. Peter Snowden pops the blinkers on him today which may add a little spark. CHUMPAKIDD (1) has been handy enough on straightening but not quite finished off in a couple of easier 1000m maidens recently. This is a step up for him but the claim helps as does the race fitness edge. PARISIAN HEIRESS (7) is a Written Tycoon mare on debut for Beer and Carpenter. Won a recent trial here and draws a good gate so should get every chance. SLIPSTREAM SARAH (8) is another local on debut. Did enough in a recent trial here to suggest she can play a role.
